task.description:
Implement lib/letflow/design/iss0216-pagination-prefix-guard.md (approved design, passed CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR after 1 rework) per WF-03 Step 3 (same procedure as WF-02 Step 2a). Claim this handoff by setting status to IN_PROGRESS only.

1. Verify branch: git branch --show-current must equal feature/WF03-ISS0216-20260826.
2. Add the new leading check_prefix/2 clause per the design's §2.1: matches prefix == "", raises ArgumentError with a message naming the misused function, the precondition, why it matters, and pointing at the new INV-9 invariant.
3. Add the new INV-9 moduledoc invariant and the @doc note on decode_cursor/4 per the design.
4. mix compile --warnings-as-errors -- fix and retry if FAIL.
5. mix format --check-formatted.
6. Confirm no existing call site's behavior changes: run the existing test/letflow/api/pagination_test.exs suite, quote real output.
7. Complete the handoff with artifacts_out: ["lib/letflow/api/pagination.ex"], next_action: "Route to SECURITY-REVIEWER".
8. Commit on feature/WF03-ISS0216-20260826 and push.
acceptance_criteria: check_prefix/2 raises ArgumentError when prefix == "", matching the design's §2.1 clause exactly
existing check_prefix/2 clause and decode_cursor/4's @spec are otherwise unchanged
mix compile --warnings-as-errors exits 0, real output quoted
existing test/letflow/api/pagination_test.exs suite still passes unchanged (proves no existing call site's behavior changed), real output quoted
